description: This file defines a utility enum 'TrackingAreaSupport' providing a static method to reset mouse tracking areas on an NSView, managing NSTrackingArea objects.

classes.name: TrackingAreaSupport
classes.description: An enum containing static methods related to managing NSTrackingArea instances for an NSView.

methods.name: resetMouseTracking
methods.description: A static method that removes an existing NSTrackingArea from an NSView and adds a new one with specified options, updating the tracking parameter.
